title: Toddler Boy Standing by Armchair, 1930s Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Douglas boy trying to
make us believe he is about
3 yrs old! He was 16 mos
on Dec 19th & is just beginning
to walk.

038K
description: A sweet domestic snapshot featuring a 16-month-old toddler named Douglas standing proudly beside a large upholstered floral armchair and holding a small toy. Dressed in a dark knit romper, tights, and baby shoes, the child balances upright in a sunny living room interior featuring patterned drapes, a side cabinet, and a pendant lamp. A handwritten inscription on the reverse tenderly notes his milestone of learning to walk around mid-December.
